title: feat: connect MCP apps through a principal-bound relay plugin

commit.messageHeadline: feat(mcp-relay): connect remote MCP clients to Gateway sessions
fix(mcp-relay): repair session creation and use terminal replies
feat(gateway): allow opt-in Control UI framing
feat(mcp-relay): advertise the direct Control UI URL
docs: explain direct Control UI embedding in ChatGPT
chore(mcp-relay): fix lint findings
docs(mcp-relay): require a public, ungated Control UI URL for ChatGPT…
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into steipete/openai-plugi…
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into steipete/openai-plugi…
fix(mcp-relay): use the SDK record guard and cover openKeyedStoreV2 i…
feat(gateway): add service-bound remote Control UI ingress
fix(mcp-relay): merge duplicate SDK import
feat(gateway): prepare remote Control UI enrollment contract
refactor(gateway): use regular device tokens for remote Control UI in…
feat(gateway): support credential-free embedded Control UI ingress
refactor(mcp-relay): remove unshipped direct Control UI embedding
feat(mcp-relay): tunnel the Control UI through remote ingress
fix(gateway): give remote Control UI upgrade sockets net.Socket timeouts
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/steipete/control-ui-remote-ingre…
fix(gateway): grant the ingress ceiling to returning embedded browsers
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/steipete/control-ui-remote-ingre…
perf(mcp-relay): pass compressed and cacheable Control UI responses t…
fix(gateway): complete embedded Control UI owner reads
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/steipete/control-ui-remote-ingre…
feat(ui): add embedder Gateway switcher transport
feat(gateway): bind remote ingress and RPC to live principals
fix(ui): keep remote ingress connections tokenless
test(gateway): require tokenless ingress HTTP reads
feat(mcp-relay): bind connected apps to approving principals
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into steipete/openai-plugi…
Merge commit '6112e37e00f31076058bc959815ba52e1f70a560' into steipete…
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into steipete/openai-plugi…
refactor(gateway): simplify remote ingress ownership and adapters
refactor(gateway): remove ingress accounting and settlement
refactor(mcp-relay): simplify plugin authority and tunnel ownership
refactor(mcp-relay): simplify state and tunnel ownership
refactor(plugins): complete principal-bound ingress factory cutover
fix(mcp-relay): reopen retired bindings and bound UI buffers
fix(mcp-relay): evict bindings retired by unsupported auth
build(mcp-relay): refresh generated Control UI assets
test(mcp-relay): bind the retired ingress mock explicitly
fix(mcp-relay): serialize grant writes and bound pending uploads
fix(mcp-relay): preserve active grant authority
chore: merge main before splitting remote ingress
feat: isolate MCP relay plugin on the core ingress API
chore: refresh relay config metadata after main merge
